prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE standalone square transparent mineral-overlay master for reduction to a 16x16 Minecraft ore-block texture.
Primary request: Hotstone, variant 2, RICHER deposit role. One modest local breccia pocket of a few angular matrix fragments with one tiny offset fissure; broad clear host gaps between, no web. Geology: hydrothermal crackle breccia with angular clast margins. This is one incidental small window into a larger deposit; family identity emerges across many varied blocks in a patch.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent RGBA; every region outside actual mineral clusters alpha zero. No rendered stone, deepslate, matte, checkerboard or scene.
Style/medium: intentional Minecraft Java 16x16-style square pixel clusters authored at high resolution, hard crisp stepped edges, a few flat medium values, no soft painting.
Composition/framing: LOCALLY richer but modest: target 25–45 visible pixels of 256 after reduction, one partial main exposure and at most one sparse associated trace occupying roughly 10–18% of the face. Broad clear gaps. Do not show an entire seam, network, geological diagram, or standalone composition in this block.
Materials/textures: subdued gray-brown matrix, at most a couple dull rust-red grains at junctions; no lava orange. Mostly opaque mineral cluster pixels in medium values close to stone, restrained local contrast. No blanket opacity fade; no dark outlining, highlight rails or raised/carved relief.
Constraints: exactly one 1:1 square PNG at least 1024x1024 with real transparent alpha; one mineral overlay only; no host pixels; no frame, panel, text, label or watermark.
Avoid: lava network, stars, glowing rings, full crackle web; whole-face composition, complete repeated structures, decorative speckles, drawn checkerboard, gray/color backdrop, haze, vignette, shadow, glow, gradients, antialiasing, smooth painting, photorealism.
disposition: Retained unchanged as first pattern within category; active human review
